{"metadata":{"description":"Easily view your CLiProxyAPI quota in DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1336684643","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-client-ui-cpa-quota","slug":"wkscc310/dsh-client-ui-cpa-quota","topics":["cliproxyapi","deepseek","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Easily view your CLiProxyAPI quota in DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-client-ui-cpa-quota"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web UI plugin that shows CLIProxyAPI quota right where you look: a native-s"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"tyled ring beside the model picker, and a CPA-management-style settings card listing **every account"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"'s quota windows** in one place."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- Zero dependencies, plain JavaScript, no build step.
- Instances are discovered automatically from "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"your DSH provider `baseURL`s — no model lists, no config file required.
- Everything runs browser-si"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"de; your management keys never leave this browser's `localStorage`."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Collapsed card"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The settings card stays collapsed like the built-in ones — plain title/description, expand for the d"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"tings card stays collapsed like the built-in ones — plain title/description, expand for the details."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### All accounts, CPA-management style"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Expand it and every account of every instance is listed with its subscription plan, provider badge, "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"and all quota windows (5-hour / weekly / monthly) — not filtered by the current model. (Demo data fr"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"om `tests/mock-cpa.mjs`.)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Ring beside the model picker"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Hover the ring next to the selected model for matching accounts, providers, plans, windows, and rese"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"e ring next to the selected model for matching accounts, providers, plans, windows, and reset times."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Reads models and `baseURL` values from DSH providers automatically; no model list to maintain.
- F"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ingerprints each `baseURL` as CLIProxyAPI and never leaves an empty ring on ordinary OpenAI-compatib"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"le endpoints.
- Supports multiple CLIProxyAPI instances and accounts, filtering the hover tooltip to"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" the selected model while the settings panel always shows everything.
- Orders windows as `5-hour → "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"weekly → monthly → daily`; the ring uses the first available window in that order.
- Queries Codex, "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"Claude, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Kimi, and xAI/Grok through their upstream quota APIs; other CPA pro"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"viders still expose account status and recent activity.
- **In-use account detection**: CPA's per-re"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"quest usage queue feeds a local 7-day ledger, so the tooltip shows the accounts that actually served"},{"id":"p14s9","text":" the selected model within the current refresh cycle (sorted by last use, with an "in use" badge and"},{"id":"p14s10","text":" request/token totals) and collapses the rest under "Other accounts". The in-use window follows the "},{"id":"p14s11","text":"card's refresh interval.
- Account probes run through a bounded pool with a per-request timeout — on"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"e hung upstream can never stall the refresh cycle.
- Keeps the last successful snapshot across trans"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"ient refresh failures and reuses rings across DSH screen remounts.
- Colors: green ≥20% remaining, a"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"mber <20%, red exhausted/error, gray loading or missing a management key."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- DSH **Web profile** on the current plugin contract (validated against `dsh` 0.1.1-rc.2, 0.1.2-rc.1"},{"id":"p16s2","text":", 0.1.5-rc.2, 0.1.6-alpha.1, 0.2.0-rc.2, 0.2.1-alpha.2 and 0.2.1-rc.1 — 0.1.5+ needs plugin ≥ 0.8.5 "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"for the model button's markup, 0.2.x needs ≥ 0.9.0 for the rebuilt plugins settings slot); the plugi"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"n registers in the Web UI.
- The official **Desktop app** runs the same web stack from its reserved "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"`desktop` profile — install the plugin through the app's own plugin manager (the CLI rejects `dsh pl"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"ugin --profile desktop` by design).
- A reachable CLIProxyAPI instance with its management API enabl"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ed.
- Models must be routed through a DSH provider whose `baseURL` points at the corresponding CPA i"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"nstance.
- A management key for each CPA instance. Keys entered in the settings card stay in the cur"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"rent browser's `localStorage`; YAML-managed keys remain in the YAML file."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Quick install"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The plugin declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest and is published to npm, so one command installs **and**"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" activates it — no config editing, no git, no build:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Prefer the installer? | Claude | OAuth usage/profile | week"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"ly, monthly |
| Antigravity | `retrieveUserQuotaSummary`, falling back to `fetchAvailableModels` | 5"},{"id":"p44s3","text":"-hour, weekly, monthly |
| Gemini CLI | Google quota endpoint | 5-hour, weekly, daily |
| Kimi | `/c"},{"id":"p44s4","text":"oding/v1/usages` | provider-defined |
| xAI / Grok | billing, with a paid-account health fallback | "},{"id":"p44s5","text":"weekly, monthly |
| Other CPA providers | auth-file status and recent activity | provider-defined |"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"## How detection works"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"1. The plugin builds a model → `baseURL` index from DSH `llm.providers` and `settings.describe`, nor"},{"id":"p46s2","text":"malizing away the protocol, `www.`, and a trailing `/v1`.
2. It requests `<baseURL>/v0/management/us"},{"id":"p46s3","text":"age-statistics-enabled` for each provider base.
3. A 401 containing `management`/`unauthorized`, or "},{"id":"p46s4","text":"a CPA-shaped 2xx, identifies CLIProxyAPI. Typical 404s, other responses, and network failures are no"},{"id":"p46s5","text":"t added as quota instances.
